title: Advances and challenges in infrared-visible image fusion: a comprehensive review of techniques and applications
core_idea: Provide a unified, deployment-aware review of infrared–visible image fusion that organizes methods along an interface–attention–alignment coordinate system, covers classical spatial/transform pipelines and contemporary deep paradigms (generative, discriminative, multi-task, hybrid/transformer, dynamic), synthesizes fidelity–robustness–efficiency trade-offs, and introduces a comparison-to-deployment protocol coupling fusion metrics with task accuracy, latency, memory footprint, and condition-performance characterization; offer practical recipes and guidance on temporal consistency, robustness auditing, and physics-grounded interpretability.
tldr: A unified, deployment-focused review of infrared–visible image fusion methods and practical guidance for task-aware, robust, and efficient fusion design.
